info.name: Document Signing Platform
info.description:
Full API collection for the Document Signing Platform.

## Authentication
- **Auth endpoints** – no auth required
- **User / Envelope endpoints** – require `Authorization: Bearer <jwt>` (obtain from `/api/auth/login`)
- **Merchant / Envelope endpoints** – require `X-Api-Key: <merchant-api-key>` (returned when merchant is created)
- **Portal endpoints** – token is embedded in the URL path

## Variables
Set these collection variables before running:
| Variable | Description |
|---|---|
| `baseUrl` | e.g. `http://localhost:5163` |
| `jwtToken` | Bearer JWT from login |
| `merchantApiKey` | API key from create-merchant |
| `merchantId` | GUID from create-merchant |
| `envelopeId` | GUID from create-envelope |
| `signingToken` | Token from signing invitation email |
| `userId` | GUID from login JWT `sub` claim |

item.name: Envelopes
item.description: Multi-signer signing envelopes. All requests require `X-Api-Key` (merchant API key).

request.description:
Initiates a signing envelope. Sends email invitations to all signers.

**Header**
| Header | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `X-Api-Key` | ✅ | Merchant API key |

**Body – top-level**
| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | string | ✅ | Envelope display name |
| `merchantId` | UUID | ✅ | Must match the API key owner |
| `documents` | array | ✅ | At least one document |
| `signers` | array | ✅ | At least one signer |
| `tokenTtlDays` | int | ❌ | Per-envelope signing window (days). Must be **1–365** if provided. Omit or `null` to use server default (`App:EnvelopeExpiryDays`, typically 7). |

**Body – each `documents[]` item**
| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `documentTitle` | string | ✅ | Human-readable title |
| `documentFileName` | string | ✅ | Filename with extension (e.g. `contract.pdf`) |
| `documentBase64` | string | ✅ | Base64-encoded file bytes |
| `documentContentType` | string | ❌ | `application/pdf`, `application/msword`, or `application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document`. If omitted, inferred from file extension. |

**Body – each `signers[]` item**
| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | ✅ | Signer full name |
| `email` | string | ✅ | Invitation sent here |
| `role` | string | ✅ | Free text, e.g. `"Signer"`, `"Counter-Signer"` |
| `order` | int | ✅ | Signing order (1-based) |
| `message` | string | ✅ | Personal note in the invitation email |

**`tokenTtlDays` validation**
| Value | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| Omitted / `null` | Uses server default (typically 7 days) |
| `1`–`365` | Signing link expires this many days from creation |
| `< 1` or `> 365` | `400 Bad Request` |
Returns all envelopes for the authenticated merchant.

Returns envelope metadata and signer statuses.

| Param | Location | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | URL path | ✅ | Envelope GUID |

Returns each signer's signed document as base64. `signedDocumentBase64` is `null` if not yet signed.

Cancels an envelope, preventing any further signing. Only envelopes in `Processing`, `Sent`, or `Signed` state can be cancelled. Returns `204 No Content` on success.

**Envelope status lifecycle**
| Status | Description |
|---|---|
| `Processing` | Request accepted; system preparing invitation emails |
| `Sent` | Invitation emails queued for all signers |
| `Signed` | At least one signer has signed (multi-signer in progress) |
| `Completed` | All signers have completed |
| `Failed` | System error during send or stamping |
| `Cancelled` | Sender cancelled before completion |
| `Expired` | Signing window elapsed without completion |
| `Rejected` | A signer explicitly rejected the document |

item.name: Portal (Signing Flow)
item.description: Public endpoints used by the signer portal page. Token is embedded in the URL path — obtained from the signing email link.

variable.description: REQUIRED – signing token from email link

request.description:

| `contentType` | string | MIME type |

| `documentFileName` | string | Original file name |
| `expiresAt` | datetime | Token expiry (UTC) |

variable.description: REQUIRED – signing token from email link

request.description:

| Param | Location | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `token` | URL path | ✅ | HMAC-signed signing token |

variable.description: REQUIRED – signing token from email link

request.description:
Submits the claimant's drawn or typed signature. Enqueues a background job to stamp the document.

| Param | Location | Required | Notes |

**Body**
| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|

variable.description: REQUIRED – signing token from email link

request.description:
Signer rejects the document. Sets the envelope status to `Rejected` and prevents further signing.

| Param | Location | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|

**Body**
| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `reason` | string | ❌ | Optional rejection reason recorded in the audit log |

item.name: Analytics
item.description: Platform-wide analytics and trend data. Requires `Authorization: Bearer <jwt>` with **Admin** role.

request.description:
Returns total counts for users, envelopes, signed documents, and support tickets across the platform.

**Response fields**
| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `totalUsers` | int | All registered users |
| `totalEnvelopesSent` | int | All envelopes created |
| `totalEnvelopesSigned` | int | Envelopes with status Completed |
| `totalEnvelopesCancelled` | int | Envelopes with status Cancelled |
| `totalDocumentsSigned` | int | Individual signed document records |
| `totalTickets` | int | All support tickets |
| `openTickets` | int | Tickets with status Open |
| `inProgressTickets` | int | Tickets with status InProgress |
| `resolvedTickets` | int | Tickets with status Resolved |
| `closedTickets` | int | Tickets with status Closed |

query.description: OPTIONAL – number of days to look back (7–90, default 30)

request.description:
Returns daily activity counts for user registrations, envelopes sent, documents signed, and support tickets opened over the specified period.

| Query param | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `days` | int | ❌ | Look-back window: 7–90 days. Default 30. |

**Response fields**
| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `userRegistrations` | DailyCount[] | New user sign-ups per day |
| `envelopesSent` | DailyCount[] | Envelopes created per day |
| `documentsSigned` | DailyCount[] | Documents signed per day |
| `ticketsCreated` | DailyCount[] | New support tickets opened per day |

**DailyCount shape:** `{ "date": "2026-03-15", "count": 3 }`

item.name: Users

request.description: Returns all registered users. Requires `Admin` role.

header.description: REQUIRED – own user or Admin JWT

request.description:
Returns a user by GUID. Admins may look up any user; regular users may only look up themselves.

| Param | Location | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | URL path | ✅ | User GUID |

header.description: REQUIRED – own user or Admin JWT

request.description:
Updates a user profile. Regular users may only change their own `name`. Only Admins may change `accessRole`.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |

item.name: Tickets
item.description:
Support ticket system — users raise tickets, admins manage them.

**User endpoints** require `Authorization: Bearer <jwt>`.
**Admin endpoints** require `Authorization: Bearer <admin-jwt>`.

Valid `type` values: `Bug` | `Feedback` | `FeatureRequest`
Valid `status` values: `Open` | `InProgress` | `Resolved` | `Closed`
Valid `priority` values: `Low` | `Medium` | `High`

request.description:
Creates a new support ticket for the authenticated user. Status is always `Open` on creation.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | string | ✅ | Short summary |
| `description` | string | ✅ | Full description |
| `type` | string | ✅ | `Bug` \| `Feedback` \| `FeatureRequest` |
Returns all tickets raised by the currently authenticated user, sorted by creation date descending.

header.description: REQUIRED — own user or Admin JWT

request.description: Returns full ticket detail including all messages. Regular users may only access their own tickets (returns 403 otherwise). Admins can access any ticket.

header.description: REQUIRED — own user or Admin JWT

request.description: Appends a message to the ticket thread. `senderType` is set automatically: `"User"` for regular users, `"Admin"` for admin users. Returns `201 Created` with the new `TicketMessageResponse`.
Returns all tickets across all users, sorted by creation date descending. **Admin role required.**

Updates ticket status and optionally sets priority. Returns `204 No Content` on success. **Admin role required.**

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `status` | string | ✅ | `Open` \| `InProgress` \| `Resolved` \| `Closed` |
| `priority` | string | ❌ | `Low` \| `Medium` \| `High`; omit or `null` to clear |

item.name: Signer Contacts
item.description: Saved contact management — list, search, create, update, delete, CSV import/export. All endpoints require JWT Bearer authentication and operate only on the caller's own contacts.

request.description: Returns all active signer contacts for the authenticated user, sorted by name.

query.description: Partial name or email to search for (case-insensitive)

request.description: Case-insensitive substring match on `name` and `email`. Returns up to 10 results. Designed for use as an autocomplete source on the send form.

Creates a new signer contact. `email` must be unique per user — returns `409 Conflict` if a contact with that email already exists.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | ✅ | Full name |
| `email` | string | ✅ | Must be unique per user |
| `role` | string | ❌ | Default: `"signer"` |
| `phone` | string | ❌ | Optional phone number |
| `company` | string | ❌ | Optional company name |

Updates all fields of an existing contact. Returns `404` if not found or owned by another user. Set `isActive` to `false` to disable without deleting.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | ✅ | Full name |
| `email` | string | ✅ | Must remain unique per user |
| `role` | string | ✅ | Role string |
| `phone` | string | ❌ | Pass `null` to clear |
| `company` | string | ❌ | Pass `null` to clear |
| `isActive` | bool | ✅ | `false` to soft-disable |
Soft-deletes the contact (`isActive = false`). Returns `204 No Content` on success, `404` if not found or owned by another user.

formdata.description: CSV file to import. Required columns: name, email. Optional: role, phone, company.

request.description:
Imports contacts from a `.csv` file upload (`multipart/form-data`). Existing contacts matched by email are updated; new ones are created.

**Required CSV columns:** `name`, `email`

**Optional CSV columns:** `role` (default `signer`), `phone`, `company`

Returns an import summary: `{ imported, skipped, failed, errors[] }`.

Downloads all contacts (active and inactive) for the authenticated user as a `text/csv` file named `signer-contacts.csv`.

**CSV columns:** `Name`, `Email`, `Role`, `Phone`, `Company`, `IsActive`, `CreatedAt`
